business_overview.one_sentence: CTR Holdings is a Singapore-based contractor providing structural engineering works and wet architectural works.

segments.business_substance: Reinforced concrete works and precast installation works
segments.source: Annual Report 2025/26, revenue note and MD&A, pages 4 and 93

segments.business_substance: Masonry, plastering/screeding, tiling and waterproofing works
segments.source: Annual Report 2025/26, revenue note and MD&A, pages 4 and 93

segments.business_substance: Construction main contracting revenue newly reported in FY2025/2026
segments.source: Annual Report 2025/26, revenue note and MD&A, pages 4 and 93

business_overview.revenue_model: Construction revenue is recognised over time; payment is generally due within 30 to 60 days from billing, with retentions released after quality/maintenance periods.
business_notes: All revenue is derived in Singapore and all non-current assets are located in Singapore.
At 28 February 2026, the group had 29 projects on hand with aggregate contract sum about S$975 million, of which S$423 million had been recognised as revenue.
Major customer concentration is material: Customer D contributed S$107.054 million in FY2025/2026.

profit_cash_conversion.assessment: Three-year OCF/net profit is strong on aggregate, but individual years swing materially because contract assets, receivables, trade payables and contract liabilities move with project timing. Use a haircut rather than the best-year cash flow.

gaps: Annual report does not disclose parent-company cash versus operating-subsidiary cash split.
No precise necessary operating cash reserve is disclosed; owner-earnback analysis estimates it from construction costs and working-capital volatility.
Maintenance capex is not separately disclosed from growth capex; owner-earnback analysis uses recent capex history conservatively.
